note: SHARED consulting-project pool (used by every profile, not per-profile). Each entry is an anonymized client engagement keyed by industry. At generation, extraction picks 2 industries from this list; code hands the matching entries to the profile's consulting company. `label` is the SHORT client-vertical word used in the résumé master line ("did X for a <label> client") — keep it a natural single vertical (fintech, healthcare, SaaS), NOT the long category name. `aliases` help the extractor match. `client` is a fuller anonymized descriptor. Summaries are 1 paragraph, concrete on architecture/scale/challenge, free of proper nouns. Only real business VERTICALS belong here — not horizontals/tech-categories (e.g. no 'AI/ML Platforms'), since those don't read as a client sector.

projects.label: fintech
projects.summary: Built two flagship AI products for a top-tier retail bank under financial-regulator scrutiny. The first delivered real-time personalization in a mobile banking app for 1.5M+ users — spending insights, automated micro-savings, budgeting, a multilingual conversational assistant (1M+ questions across 12 languages), and cash-flow forecasts — the core challenge being to move real-time personalization off a legacy mainframe onto an event-driven platform with regulator-required explainability on every decision. The second was a reinforcement-learning trade-execution agent for 8,000+ capital-markets users that held its benchmark through extreme market volatility, with hard trading guardrails, simulation-based validation, staged rollout, and a trader-facing explainability view.

projects.label: media
projects.summary: Delivered a consumer streaming platform serving 90M+ subscribers across web, mobile, and connected TV under ad-supported/standard/premium tiers, including a high-stakes merger of two catalogs into one product under a hard multi-quarter launch deadline. Work spanned the subscription/entitlement/payments backbone, a unified catalog + metadata platform, launch-performance work that cut app and video start times 20-28%, a home-screen recommender that lifted engagement ~11%, a churn model, and a content-operations RAG assistant — all on AWS/EKS with a large multi-service footprint governed by an operational-metadata schema for cost and incident triage.

projects.label: healthcare
projects.summary: Delivered a HIPAA-regulated care-coordination platform for a digital-health company managing roughly 340k chronic-condition patients across 1,200+ provider sites. Built the event-driven backbone that ingested EHR/FHIR feeds, claims, and device telemetry into a longitudinal patient record, a risk-stratification model that flagged rising-risk patients for outreach, lifting outreach precision 23 points over the prior rules-based list, and a clinician-facing summarization assistant grounded strictly in the patient's own chart, cutting chart-review time from about 18 minutes to under 4 with PHI redaction and citation-back to source. The core constraints were auditability, consent-scoped data access, and explainability on every clinical-adjacent recommendation, running on a HITRUST-aligned cloud footprint with per-record access logging.

projects.label: B2B SaaS
projects.summary: Re-platformed a multi-tenant B2B SaaS product from a monolith toward domain-oriented services for a company serving about 3,100 enterprise tenants. Delivered tenant isolation and per-tenant configuration that cut cross-tenant latency incidents 64%, a usage-metering and entitlements layer feeding billing, a versioned public GraphQL/REST API with rate limits, and an admin analytics surface. The hard problems were noisy-neighbor isolation at scale, backward-compatible schema evolution across long-lived tenants, and enterprise SSO/SCIM integration — shipped on Kubernetes with blue-green deploys and SLO-backed observability.

projects.label: insurance
projects.summary: Delivered claims and underwriting automation for a property-and-casualty insurer, modernizing a legacy claims platform. Built the end-to-end claims-resolution workflow, rules-driven claim routing, and a machine-learning risk-assessment model that improved routing accuracy 19%, plus data-processing jobs over 2.4M historical claims that surfaced lifecycle bottlenecks. The work centered on integrating ML into a regulated claims pipeline with explainable decisions, and on refactoring legacy code for stability at a peak volume near 7,800 claims a day.

projects.label: e-commerce
projects.summary: Built and scaled merchant- and shopper-facing features for a high-traffic commerce platform engineered to survive peak sale events (Black Friday / Cyber Monday-class traffic). Delivered GraphQL storefront/admin APIs, Kafka-based real-time event pipelines behind storefront, admin, and analytics surfaces, and AI commerce features — vector search and recommendations over a 12M-SKU catalog powered by fine-tuned embeddings. The core challenges were resilience and traffic isolation under spikes, catalog-scale search relevance, and holding checkout p95 under 380 ms through a 14x traffic spike.

projects.label: developer-tools
projects.summary: Delivered a developer-infrastructure product for a company building cloud/DevOps tooling. Built the control plane and API, a scalable job/execution layer, and multi-cloud provisioning across three clouds with Terraform-driven infrastructure-as-code, plus first-class observability across metrics, tracing, and SLOs. The hard problems were multi-tenant isolation, safe rollout of infrastructure changes with plan-review gates and drift detection that cut failed changes 62%, and holding control-plane p99 under 240 ms as customer workloads grew sixfold.

projects.label: cybersecurity
projects.summary: Built detection and response tooling for a security company, processing roughly 90k events per second to surface threats. Delivered a streaming analytics pipeline over security events, ML-based anomaly and fraud detection with guardrail metrics that cut false-positive alerts 47%, and an investigation surface with investigator search holding p95 under 900 ms across a 40-day hot window. The core constraints were precision under alert-fatigue pressure, tamper-evident audit trails, and least-privilege access throughout — with the detection models continuously monitored for drift as attack patterns shifted.

projects.label: logistics
projects.summary: Delivered a logistics-optimization platform for a supply-chain company coordinating about 26k shipments a day across 40+ carriers and warehouses. Built real-time tracking ingestion, a routing/optimization engine balancing cost, time, and capacity constraints, and forecasting models for demand and ETA that cut arrival-estimate error 31%. The central challenges were optimizing under competing constraints at fleet scale, reconciling messy multi-source telemetry into one schema, and keeping the live-tracking surface accurate under bursty event volume.

projects.label: telecom
projects.summary: Built backend provisioning and order-management services for a telecom operator, automating account creation and activation across phone, internet, and TV packages for roughly 2.3M subscriber accounts. Delivered RESTful and SOAP integrations synchronizing state across multiple legacy backend systems, complex order orchestration, and microservices deployed on Kubernetes with horizontal autoscaling that absorbed eightfold order volume through peak promotional periods. The core work was reliable state synchronization across brittle legacy systems and accurate billing and service configuration at scale, cutting provisioning errors 43%.

projects.label: proptech
projects.summary: Delivered a property-technology platform for a proptech company, unifying listings, valuation, and transaction workflows. Built the data pipeline ingesting listing, geospatial, and market feeds, an automated valuation model that cut median valuation error 12%, a search/recommendation surface over properties, and document workflows for transactions. The hard problems were reconciling heterogeneous property data sources, keeping valuation models accurate as markets moved, and holding p95 geospatial search under 300 ms over 3.7M active listings.

projects.label: legal-tech
projects.summary: Built a contract- and compliance-automation platform for a legal-technology company. Delivered document ingestion and clause extraction using NLP at 0.91 F1, a retrieval-augmented assistant that answered questions grounded in a 1.8M-document corpus with citation-back to source, and workflow/approval tooling with a full audit trail. The core constraints were accuracy and grounding on high-stakes legal text with ungrounded answers held under 2%, fine-grained access control, and defensible auditability on every automated action.

projects.label: HR-tech
projects.summary: Delivered a talent platform for an HR-technology company, matching candidates to roles across an 11M-profile pool. Built the ingestion and normalization pipeline over resumes and job data, an embedding-based matching/ranking system that lifted recruiter-accepted matches 18%, a candidate-facing application flow, and analytics for employers. The central challenges were matching relevance and fairness with bias-aware ranking and guardrail metrics, normalizing extremely messy free-text inputs, and holding p95 candidate search under 420 ms.
